rulesets.m: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. A hostile creature seen THREE-QUARTER FRONT, FULL BODY, common baseline. NEUTRAL DESATURATED GRAY-WHITE only so a later tint can color it. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS, 3 columns by 2 rows, clear magenta gaps. Same creature, scale, camera in every cell. Poses MUST differ. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. No text, no labels, no borders.
